answer: A workable sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation: each identity must lock a refundable deposit before its votes count, and its weight grows only through verified, useful work. Forging many identities costs capital per identity, and misbehavior forfeits the bond - the quill signing each claim also signs away its deposit if it lies. Trust climbs toward its zenith slowly, not in bulk, so an attacker wanting a thousand fake voices must fund a thousand bonds and risk losing them all. A quartz-hard audit trail lets anyone verify each history, making cheap swarms economically irrational.
